name: Deep Impact
source:
Nick, a recent high school graduate, has decided to stay home while his parents are overseas. He moves into Sarah's, family friend, home along with her two daughters Sophia and Sandra. While completing a summer course, Nick gets roped into several medical trials by the crazy Dr. Amanda Ling as well as doing a favor for the town mafia boss, Toni Cappelli. 

[From [url=https://vanillacproductions.itch.io/deep-impact]Official Website[/url]]
translation:
刚刚高中毕业的尼克，在父母出国期间，决定留在当地。他搬进了家中朋友莎拉的住所，与她的两个女儿索菲娅和桑德拉同住。在修读暑期课程期间，尼克被疯狂的阿曼达·林医生拉去参加了几项医学试验，还得替镇上的黑帮头目托尼·卡佩利帮一个忙。
